input.quote: This Agreement will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months unless either Party gives six (6) months written notice of its intent to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Both term clauses provide automatic renewal but with non-renewal notice windows far beyond the fallback of 60 days: the Base Agreement (§ 4.0) requires six months' (approx. 180 days) notice, and the Statement of Work (§ 2.0) requires twelve months' notice for six-month renewal periods — meaning notice must be given before the renewal period even begins. Windows longer than 90 days are walk-away territory under the rule, so this fails the fallback on a material term and binds us to renewals we cannot practically exit. There is also no cap on renewal pricing (§ 5.3 addresses only prices on termination). Redline shortens the notice to 30 days, aligns the Attachment renewal period at 12 months, and adds a 60-day renewal reminder plus a lesser-of-CPI-or-3% uplift cap; a 60-day window with a 5% cap is offered as fallback.

proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice to 30 days, set renewal terms at 12 months, add renewal reminder and cap on renewal price increases
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the non-renewal notice window to 30 days, aligned the Attachment renewal period with the 12-month Base term, and added a renewal reminder and a cap on renewal price increases (lesser of CPI and 3%). Six- and twelve-month exit notice periods sit beyond our walk-away threshold of 90 days; if helpful we can live with a 60-day notice window and a 5% uplift cap as a fallback.

ops.oldText: This Agreement will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months unless either Party gives six (6) months written notice of its intent to terminate this Agreement.
ops.newText: This Agreement will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months unless either Party gives thirty (30) days written notice, prior to the end of the then-current period, of its intent to terminate this Agreement. MSL will notify IBM of each upcoming renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current period, and any price increase applicable to a renewal period shall not exceed the lesser of the increase in the Consumer Price Index over the preceding twelve (12) months or three percent (3%).
